candidates.statement: Payment authorization calls from order time out (ReadTimeout, ~2s), so order returns 502 and gateway checkout returns 502 at ~2s. Payment p95 for /v1/authorizations is ~4875ms while inventory and redis calls succeed quickly.
candidates.uncertainty: Payment still returns 200 on some authorizations; the slow subset's internal cause is unconfirmed.

report.explanation: Traces show checkout 502s caused by order's payment call timing out (~2s ReadTimeout), while inventory/redis succeed. Payment p95 latency ~4875ms supports downstream payment latency as the bounded cause; payment-side traces were excluded, so internal cause remains unconfirmed.
